column1: # 4 MB ESP32 boards running as a microReticulum node: 2.25 MB app
# The default no_ota.csv (2 MB app) is too small for the ScotMesh pages on
# RNode NG 2.0/2.1 and LoRa32 v2.1. The store only holds the node's identity
# settings and path table (a few hundred KB); the console image is not usable
# on these boards because the same partition is mounted as LittleFS.
